_about: Rules the browser and the server both apply, kept once. Read by backend/config/shared.py and imported in the browser as '@shared/rules.json'. Change a value here and both sides change; never copy one into code. shared/README.md says more.

overdue._about: What finishing a task after its due date costs. Each day late takes cut_per_day of the task's XP, down to floor (a share of the full XP, never less than 1 XP). A date with no time is due by the end of that day. Tasks finished before since keep the full XP they were paid. backend/api/tasks.py charges it; frontend/src/utils/overdue.ts shows it.

struggle.label: Could not focus
struggle.fix: Put your phone in another room and set a 25-minute timer before you start

struggle.label: Did not know where to start
struggle.fix: Start with one worked example before you try one yourself

struggle.label: Bigger than it looked
struggle.fix: Split it into 15-minute pieces and book only the first

struggle.label: Ran out of time
struggle.fix: Book it earlier in the day, at half the size

struggle.label: Low energy
struggle.fix: Do it at the time of day you're sharpest

struggle.label: Kept getting interrupted
struggle.fix: Put it on the calendar as a block so the time is protected

went_well.label: Had a clear run at it
went_well.phrase: had a clear run at it

live._about: Live blocks: a space's page reading the account's own data. backend/tracking/live.py reads each source; frontend/src/components/Spaces/LiveBlock.tsx draws it. windows/weeks/ahead are the choices a block offers, in days or weeks. poll_ms is how often an open page asks whether anything changed.

background._about: The 'About you' answers from the last step of sign-up. How detailed they are decides the head start Analytics gives the account: days counted toward its unlock waits. A level needs at least `words` words in all and `answered` questions with `answered_words` or more; the first level that fits wins. backend/tracking/background.py and frontend/src/utils/background.ts both read this; shared/cases/background_detail.json pins them.
